description: A delegated listener sets the same 3 s timer for every click, and navigates when it runs only for links of the app (a.later); an analytics listener sets a harmless 3 s timer for every click. The neutral activation of each copy runs both timers ahead of their time and sees them change nothing for a neutral spot; in each probe they are run ahead of their time again, for the element: the two a.later links navigate (they are links: no link-acts-as-button, never likely), and the link that only shows a panel acts as a button, likely, without waiting 3 s.
